name: Maintained normally-closed pushbutton
summary: A maintained NC pushbutton retains its actuated open state until the documented return action.
description: A maintained NC pushbutton retains its actuated open state until the documented return action. This affects permissive and stopping circuits that depend on contact continuity.
readingNotes: Determine how the operator returns to the reference position.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Maintained NC operation does not alone establish an emergency-stop safety function.
